**Triage: `domain:engine`; `Bug`; `priority:p2`; `pm:queue`. ⭐ And half 2 is escalated OUT of the #5499 freeze — by the freeze's own exception clause, which assigns that call to this seat.**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+177 · 2026-09-11T02:1xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. `origin/main` @ `86c50528695a1d46649405bd47e81dae858127d7`.

### ✅ The fence held, and the card is the proof

R+176 fenced #17124 to one package (「Both halves of this defect live in `packages/services/service-analytics`. One package, one lane, one worktree」) and said anything outside it gets filed rather than folded. PR #17593 did exactly that, and this card is the residue. ⛔ Nothing here reads as scope creep.

⭐ And the residue is **larger than this seat measured**: R+176 found **two** faces disagreeing; this card's table finds **four faces with three interpretations**, plus `[]`, `['a','b','c']` and `[null,null]` shapes that were never probed. ⚠️ Recording that as a correction to my own R+176 reading, not as a complaint — the divergence was wider than I said it was.

### Routing — both halves are one lane

| half | path | lane |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — the conformance kit has no ARITY case | `packages/core/src/utils/analytics-date-range-conformance.ts` | `domain:engine` (`packages/core`) |
| 2 — `driver-memory`'s cube face drops an odd-sized window | `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts:873-878` | `domain:engine` (`packages/drivers/driver-*`) |

⇒ one lane, ⛔ no cross-domain exception path.

### ⭐ The two halves are MECHANICALLY inseparable — measured, not argued

This is the reading that decides the freeze question, so it is taken explicitly. The kit's consumers on `origin/main`:

```
packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/analytics-date-range-conformance.test.ts
packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/date-range-array-arm-arity.test.ts
packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics-date-range-conformance.test.ts     ⬅
packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics-date-range-timezone.test.ts
packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics-date-range-utc-window.test.ts
```

⇒ **`driver-memory` is a registered face of the kit.** So adding an ARITY case (half 1) puts that case to `driver-memory`, and per half 2's reading it fails. ⇒ ⛔ half 1 cannot land "on its own" — it lands either **with** half 2, or with `driver-memory` **exempted from the new case**.

### ⭐ The #5499 escalation — named, with the basis stated

**#5499** (`[裁决] driver-memory / driver-mongodb 投入冻结`, open, `tracking`) says the default is 「直接挂 `pm:on-hold` 引用本单,不入 `pm:queue`」, with one exception: 「若 driver-memory 的缺陷影响 CI 判绿的正确性…**由分诊轮点名升级**」. ⇒ the call belongs to this seat, and it is being made rather than deferred downward. (R+176 this seat put four cards — #17446 #17348 #17301 #17286 — on hold under that same freeze, so this is not a habit of finding exceptions.)

⚠️ **The exception applies, and the reason is not "driver-memory has a bug".** It is the third option above:

> If half 1 lands with `driver-memory` exempted from the ARITY case, the kit **reports conformance for a face it has stopped governing**.

The kit's own header states what it is for: *"a face outside the kit is a face free to grow a second interpretation — which is the exact defect #16041 was split to end."* ⇒ a green conformance run that silently excludes one registered face from one case **is a green that does not mean what it says**. That is 「影响 CI 判绿的正确性」 in the most literal sense the clause admits — ⛔ not an appeal to the defect's severity, which would not qualify.

⇒ **Escalated.** Half 2 may be worked in this card. ⛔ This escalation covers **this window-construction seam only** — it is ⛔ **not** a general thaw of #5499, and ⛔ **not** licence to touch `generateSql()` (**#17301**, `pm:on-hold` under the same freeze, still on hold).

⚠️ Maintainer may overrule; if so, the fallback is **half 1 with `driver-memory` exempted and the exemption written into the kit** — ⛔ never a silent skip.

### For the taker

- ⚠️ **Half 2 is a SOURCE READING, ⛔ not a reproduction** — the card says so. **First act is the probe** against `memory-analytics.ts:873-878`. A clean stop reporting "the window survives" is a full success.
- ⭐ **The agreed behaviour already exists**: PR #17593 made all four service-analytics faces refuse a non-two-bound array with the ADR-0112 `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_UNRECOGNIZED` / 400 envelope. ⇒ the ARITY case asserts **that** rule; ⛔ do not invent a second one.
- ⛔ **Do not touch `packages/spec`.** Whether the schema itself should refuse these shapes is **#17598**, which goes to the maintainer's decision box this round. ⚠️ If #17598 is answered "tighten the schema", this card's population shrinks but its instrument gap does not close — the kit still needs the case.
- ⛔ Do not weaken any existing kit case to make the new one pass.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T02:1xZ, 582-issue open board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `analytics-date-range-conformance\|analyticsDateRangeConformanceFindings` | **1** — #17596 |
| `memory-analytics` | **2** — #17596, #17301 |
| `ANALYTICS_DATE_RANGE_EXPLICIT_WINDOW` | **1** — #17596 |
| `driver-memory` (control) | **22** |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#17301** is the nearest neighbour and is a different seam — `generateSql()` echoing a statement the pipeline never ran — and it stays `pm:on-hold` under #5499, deliberately. **#17598** is the spec half of the same family, filed together and routed to the decision box.

`Size/model suggestion:` M — one kit case plus a driver face, two packages, and a probe before either.
